how_it_works: Every screen of the CrewConnect prototype reads its user-facing text from this file at start-up, by content_key. Edit client_text only; original_text keeps the wording before any client change. A blank client_text falls back to original_text. Keep {placeholders} exactly as written.

fields.binding: direct = read straight from this file; value_label = the screen also uses this text as an internal value, so a new wording changes the label shown but the app keeps matching on original_text; mixed = both.
fields.content_source: ui_copy = interface text; sample_data = demo people, jobs, listings and values that come from the backend in production.

notices.title: Revised minimum day rates for camera crew from 1 December
body: Following the General Body Meeting on 20 October, the Guild has revised minimum day rates for camera department members. The new rates apply to all productions shooting in Maharashtra from 1 December 2026.
Members should share the revised rate card with production managers before signing new contracts.

notices.title: Mandatory electrical safety refresher — November batch
body: All member gaffers, best boys and lighting technicians must complete the annual electrical safety refresher before 15 December. The November batch runs on 28–29 November at the Association office in Andheri.
Bring your membership card. Members who miss the refresher may not be cleared for productions using generators above 125 kVA.

notices.title: Wireless frequency guidance for outdoor shoots in Mumbai
body: Members have reported interference near Bandra–Worli and Film City on the 470–520 MHz range. Coordinate frequencies with other departments during the recce and keep a backup plan with cabled lavaliers.

notices.title: Updated location permit process for Mumbai film shoots
body: The single-window permit portal now requires a police NOC to be uploaded 72 hours before the shoot date. Line producers should plan permits for weekend shoots by Wednesday.

notices.title: Fire-safety audit for studio sets — compliance checklist
body: From December, every studio set built with timber or foam must pass a fire-safety audit before the first shooting day. The attached checklist lists what inspectors will look for.

notices.title: Workshop: prosthetic make-up for long shooting days
body: A two-day hands-on workshop on prosthetic application, skin care and removal for 14-hour shooting days. Limited to 25 members; registration closes on 30 November.

notices.title: Lens-care and camera-prep checklist for monsoon schedules
body: Shared by senior focus pullers in the collective: a practical prep checklist for humid locations, including silica rotation, lens-fog prevention and data-backup routines.

notices.title: On-set safety officer mandatory for high-fall stunts
body: For any stunt involving a fall above 3 metres, productions must appoint a certified safety officer. Stunt coordinators should confirm the officer’s name on the call sheet.

notices.title: Colour-grading workstation calibration day
body: Our quarterly calibration day for grading monitors will be held at the Banjara Hills post facility. Members can book a 30-minute slot.

notices.title: Office closed for Diwali, 7–10 November
body: The Guild office and helpline will be closed from 7 to 10 November. For urgent on-set disputes, call the emergency number on your membership card.

notices.title: New member registration window, 1–15 November
body: Applications for new members open on 1 November. Applicants need two references from existing members and proof of 60 working days in the last two years.

notices.title: Annual General Body Meeting on 20 October
body: All members are invited to the Annual General Body Meeting at Prabhadevi on 20 October at 11 am. The agenda includes the revised rate card and election of office bearers.

notices.title: Monsoon kit care: protecting recorders and booms
body: Practical tips from members on rain covers, desiccant packs and drying routines for recorders, booms and wireless kits.

notices.title: Producer helpdesk timings for September
body: The Council’s helpdesk for payment disputes and contract queries will be open Monday to Friday, 10 am to 5 pm, throughout September.

notices.title: Screening of member short films — call for entries
body: Members can submit short films completed in 2026 for the annual members’ screening. Entries close on 10 September.

notices.title: Guidelines for reusing set materials
body: Members are encouraged to list reusable flats, props and set dressing with approved vendors to cut costs and waste. Contact the Guild office for the vendor list.

content.original_text:
Dear members,
Members have reported strong interference near Film City and Aarey during evening schedules over the last three weeks. Several productions lost takes on lav channels between 6 pm and 11 pm.

Until further notice please avoid the 470-520 MHz range on outdoor night shoots in these areas. Move to the block we have listed in the frequency note, scan before every setup and keep a wired backup on the boom for dialogue scenes.

If you face interference please report it with date, time, location and your receiver model so we can share a pattern with the authorities. We have already written to the department and will update this notice when we hear back.

The full note is on our website: https://ssp-forum.org/notices/2026/october/wireless-frequency-guidance-outdoor-shoots-mumbai-film-city-aarey

Thank you for your cooperation.
Committee, SSP Forum
